verdict.rationale: AMD documents an official command-line tool, xrt-smi, for monitoring and managing the Ryzen AI NPU, so the product ecosystem does ship an official CLI. Its documented scope covers device monitoring and management only. Model execution is documented through Python/C++ APIs and the Lemonade SDK, with no CLI interface shown for those workflows. missing for 10: a documented CLI for running or serving models and agent workflows, a full command reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The xrt-smi utility is a command-line interface to monitor and manage the NPU integrated AMD CPUs.
